tools.name: get_mileage_rate
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for the IRS standard mileage rate on a day, for example "what was the business mileage rate on 15 March 2026", "how much per mile can I deduct for charity driving", "medical mileage rate in 2025". Pass seller_country

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_feedback_reply · Private data: get_tax_parameters, tax_duty · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_feedback_reply · Private data: get_tax_parameters, tax_duty · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
